_note: R23 Trips, design-final-v2.md section 3.3 schema v2. Saltwater, spearfishing and freshwater only: the hunting factor tables land with the hunting half. Every unit below is checked at build time against pipeline.build.trips.SOURCE_FIELD_UNITS, which carries the document that established it; a unit declared here that disagrees with the published one fails the build.
_b3_note: There is no default_threshold field in this file, on any record. A number the user did not set is not a condition the user set. Suggested starting values live in setup_sheet below, are rendered ONLY as editable controls, and become thresholds only after the user saves them, with origin 'user'.
_b13_note: threshold_basis describes the THRESHOLD and input_provenance describes the READING, and they are different objects because printing the second under a label claiming the first is how a NOAA satellite pixel came to be described as a number the user chose. An agency warning and an uncounted fact have no threshold at all: their threshold_basis is null and no 'Threshold:' line is printed.
_b14_note: source_disclaimer is required on every record (null only where this app has recorded no disclaimer for that feed, with the reason written beside it) and its value must be one of section 2.2's closed disclaimer strings. It renders on every line carrying that source's value, counted or not.
_n3_note: document_title appears on exactly the records whose URL has an entry in fetched_documents below, and nowhere else. N3 requires it to equal the title the fetch of that URL asserted, so a title typed by hand beside a URL is the claim the gate exists to refuse. The records still without one are named in _document_title_gaps.
_document_title_gaps: Four records cite a URL no fetch in this repository has asserted a title for, so document_title is absent from them rather than typed: fresh.plant_published (wildlife.ca.gov Fish Planting Schedule; this pipeline reads the plant records from the ArcGIS FeatureServer behind that page and has never fetched the page itself), spear.visibility_outlook (its reading is a band derived from four documents, so no single title describes it), and the two nws_alerts records (api.weather.gov is fetched by the device, not by this pipeline).

fetched_documents._note: N3's other half. A document_title above is checked byte-for-byte against the asserted_title here, and a title claimed for a URL with no entry here fails the build. Each entry records a document THIS repository fetched, and asserted_title is the title string that document states about itself.

factors._curation_note: A published fact about LAND, and it is uncounted for two separate reasons, either of which is enough. The first: the public-land layer draws boundaries and publishes no acreage column, so the number is an area this app measures over the boundaries it ships, and those boundaries are simplified for the map. The second: the unit on this column is carried from the design's own record and has never been read against a publisher's description here, so counts_now is false whatever scoreable said. Section 4.4 offered this as a criterion the user could set. It ships as a fact instead, which is what an area nobody has verified the unit of is worth.

_hunting_note: P7's hunting half, and the three things it deliberately does NOT carry. (1) No wind criterion. The National Weather Service forecast publishes wind as a string carrying its own unit, in miles per hour and often as a range, and this repository ships no conversion to the knots the model field is named for; a knots number compared against a miles-per-hour number does not fail, it matches, so nothing binds that column until the conversion exists and is pinned to code the app itself runs. Air temperature and the chance of precipitation are bound, because both arrive as numbers in units read from the publisher. (2) Nothing about an animal. There is no record here over a harvest, a tag draw, a hunter count or a survey, scoreable or not; the waterfowl result and the history pack land later and are uncountable forever. (3) No band input that belongs to hunting alone. Every counted factor a hunting activity names is a weather factor the fishing activities name too, so there is no number in this file that exists only to move a hunting screen — and the hunting screens carry no band at all, which is a fact about the app's structure and not about this table.
